ui_rules: candidate and supporting/counter evidence are presented together
technical IDs remain available in provenance details but are not primary labels
one review case requests one bounded professional decision
invalidation_rules: source fingerprint drift changes reviewed case to STALE_REVIEW
stale decision receipt remains historical and is never silently rewritten
dependent approved artifacts must treat STALE_REVIEW as invalid until re-reviewed
authority: A decision receipt records human adjudication; it does not change source evidence by itself.
